citation_heritage_recovery.claim: Dense center_projected embeddings recover citation heritage AUC > 0.75 at 21-24yr scale, superior to TF-IDF
citation_heritage_recovery.evidence: citation_heritage_24year_latest.json: cp_64 AUC 0.7667, cp_768 AUC 0.7696, cp_128 AUC 0.7669 with 730 positive pairs (2.1x 22yr); 22yr cp_64 AUC 0.7922; 21yr cp_64 AUC 0.8182

section_crosslingual_view.claim: Hierarchy Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen for cross-lingual alignment at 1K sample
section_crosslingual_view.evidence: section_crosslingual_eval_latest.json: Sachverhalt cp64 cross_lang=0.2816 (>0.2 PASS), Dispositiv cp64=0.1502 (>0.1 PASS), Erwaegungen cp64=0.0941 (<0.1 FAIL)
section_crosslingual_view.blocker: Full corpus density BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k (corpus lane)

linear_hybrid_complement.claim: Linear hybrids PASS both adversarial gates at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP below TF-IDF baseline
linear_hybrid_complement.evidence: weight_sweep_22year_latest.json: w=0.3 JP=0.6715/LangDom=0.606 PASS; w=0.4 JP=0.6725/LangDom=0.654 PASS; TF-IDF baseline JP=0.784/0.789. Scale shifts optimal weight toward semantic (19yr w=0.3, 22yr w=0.4)
linear_hybrid_complement.limitation: JP 0.61-0.67 vs TF-IDF 0.78-0.79; cross-lang recall improvement +0.036

two_mode_tradeoff.claim: No single representation dominates LangDom, JuristPref, Citation Independence at any scale
two_mode_tradeoff.evidence: Reproduced at 3yr, 15yr, 19yr, 20yr, 21yr, 22yr, 24yr, 165k. TF-IDF: LangDom~0.48/JP~0.78/CiteIndep~14%. Dense: LangDom~0.83-0.98/JP~0.05-0.43/CiteIndep~37%. Hybrids: intermediate.
two_mode_tradeoff.implication: TF-IDF = PRIMARY mode; Dense = COMPLEMENTARY modes

true_oos_ceiling.claim: True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target
true_oos_ceiling.evidence: v8 holdout (fixed): TF-IDF JP -0.015 to -0.020 under true OOS; TF-IDF baseline 0.78 has SVD leakage; zero-shot hybrids holdout JP 0.525-0.585; no representation achieves 0.7 target OOS
true_oos_ceiling.implication: Dense cannot be PRIMARY for jurist navigation

scale_characterization_12k.claim: Full-text dense inflated at small homogeneous scale, degrades at scale
scale_characterization_12k.evidence: cross_lang_same_branch: 0.656 (1K) -> 0.957 (12.5K) but separation collapses; legal area purity 0.609 -> 0.475; adversarial JP ~0.005 at 3yr (FAIL)
scale_characterization_12k.interpretation: Small-scale results reflect language model design, not legal equivalence

formal_suite_165k.claim: All center_projected variants FAIL jurist gate at maximum evaluated scale (165k)
formal_suite_165k.evidence: cp_768 JP=0.389, cp_64 JP=0.418, cp_128 JP=0.405; cross-lang recall 0.10-0.11 << 0.2; boilerplate resistance NEGATIVE; hierarchy coherence FAIL; only temporal stability and zero-shot transfer PASS

v18_coarse_hierarchy.claim: Even at 4-label branch level: best purity 0.65 < 0.7 threshold
v18_coarse_hierarchy.evidence: v18_coarse_hierarchy_results.json: linear_citation_concat best purity 0.65 < 0.7; fundamental hierarchy limitation for TF-IDF/citation representations

legal_tfidf_bge_negative.claim: Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus (6,243 decisions) FAILS adversarial suite
legal_tfidf_bge_negative.evidence: all_experiments_results.json: 6-8/14 PASS vs 14/14 baseline; ALL variants FAIL citation heritage (AUC ~0.5), branch kNN (0.26-0.39), multilingual invariance; PASS LangDom~0.49-0.50; root cause: corpus mismatch (bge_ vs bger_) and signal coverage deficits

data_blockers.claim: Three blockers prevent 174k completion; 2022-2023 embeddings exist and pass citation heritage despite progress.json failed flags
data_blockers.evidence: 1) BGE/bger ID mapping missing; 2) Parquet 2024-2026 missing (15,536 decisions); 3) Section extraction at 174k not run. Contradiction: progress.json flags 2021-2023 failed but 24yr eval (incl 2022-2023) PASSES AUC>0.75 with 730 pairs

accepted_negative_findings.claim: All negative results preserved as first-class evidence
accepted_negative_findings.evidence: Dense FAILS jurist gate all scales (JP 0.05-0.43); True OOS ceiling 0.53; v18 hierarchy max purity 0.65; citation heritage recall@10 max 0.0066; boilerplate resistance negative; raw 768dim FAILS citation heritage at 24yr (AUC 0.68); full-text dense inflated at small scale; BGE TF-IDF fails generalization
